name: squillpad
description: A local-first spatial Markdown and vector ink notebook.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @squillpad/web dev" "pnpm --filter @squillpad/server dev"
scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @squillpad/core-model build && pnpm --filter @squillpad/storage build && pnpm --filter @squillpad/synchronization build && pnpm --filter @squillpad/server build && pnpm --filter @squillpad/ui build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run test:boundaries && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck
